Description

After the latest updates, TextMeshPro Text doesn't show the Face Texture from the Text Material anymore aswell as it's emission intensity. At first I thought it was a bug with my new VRChat world that I uploaded but it's also broken in an older world of mine that I haven't updated for years which means something with the latest VRChat Update must have broken it.

It might not be a very bad or game breaking bug but it's a very important one for world creators, especially when they work a lot with Text.

Reproduction Steps

Create a Text in Unity by using TextMeshPro, pick TextMeshPro/DistanceField as the Shader for the Text. In the catergory (Face) place a texture in the texture field. Then increase the the intensity of the colour / emission of the colour. When you upload it to VRChat you will see that it won't be applying the emission such as the texture. 

Details

- Category: World

- Frequency: Always
